Alex / Priya — thanks for the questions. Below is our standard guidance and what we can provide immediately.

On Tue, Jun 9, 2026 at 9:40 AM Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finhealth.co> wrote:
> 1) Can you share the most recent pen-test report or an executive summary today?

Short answers / what we can deliver today:
- Pen test: We can immediately share a redacted executive summary (see attached: redwood-pen-test-summary-202602.pdf). The full, unredacted report is available under NDA and upon procurement engagement; we do not publish raw exploit details publicly.
- SOC 2: We are currently in the Type II audit cycle; the expected completion date is 2026-08-15. The Type II scope includes our hosted API and Dedicated offering (reserved capacity) — we'll confirm exact control mapping upon request.
- Scanning cadence: automated internal scans run weekly; authenticated external scans (saaS-facing) run monthly; third-party full pen tests are performed annually and after major infra releases.
- Vulnerability management / SLAs: critical (CVSS 9-10) — triage within 24 hours, mitigation plan within 72 hours; high (7-8.9) — triage 72 hours, remediation plan within 14 days; medium/low — tracked on a backlog with target SLAs by risk. We follow coordinated disclosure practices and will notify affected customers within 48 hours of confirmed incidents; CVE coordination is performed for issues that meet disclosure criteria.

Sharing and logistics:
- Attachment: redwood-pen-test-summary-202602.pdf (sanitized exec summary).
- For procurement questionnaires, please send to security@redwood.com — I'll assign resources to pre-fill and attach supporting artifacts.
- If FinHealth requires the full pen-test report or specific logs, we can share under an NDA (we can kick off a DocuSign/NDA flow once procurement confirms).

Next steps proposed:
1) Marissa will share our pen-test request template and a proposed timeline for sharing materials.
2) FinHealth sends the vendor questionnaire to security@redwood.com and we'll return pre-filled sections within 3 business days.
3) If needed, execute an NDA and we'll provide the full scope report within 10 business days of NDA execution.

If you want to jump on a quick call to walk through the summary, I'm available tomorrow afternoon.
